meta: Read news of a new AI model without getting swept up by "the world's most powerful": you only need to know 3 things.

muc.title: A new model every week
muc.text: Every week brings news of the world's most powerful new model, but most of it doesn't change what you do day to day.

muc.title: Three things worth reading
muc.text: A model is the brain behind an AI app. For new-model news, read three things: the price, what it does better, and when it reaches the app you use.

muc.title: Leaderboards and big words
muc.text: Skim past benchmark tables, the tests used to score AI. A high score doesn't mean it's good at your work.

muc.title: Let AI summarize it
muc.text: Paste the article into a chatbot, ask for those three things, then check the details on the official page.

muc.title: Summarize one story
muc.text: Find a recent new-model story and ask AI to summarize exactly those three things.
